name: integer_literal_beyond_int64_rejected_on_ingest
description: A bare-integer literal beyond int64 (10^20) is an int64-domain value that exceeds the domain, so ingest through the JSON->value bridge MUST raise an out-of-range error rather than silently approximating it to a double. Token shape follows domain (SPEC 2.3.2): bare digits are an int64 integer. A genuine double of this magnitude arrives in exponent shape instead (see 020). This fixture was formerly a plain-decimal formatting case; under the v3.5.3 numeric domain the value is out of range on ingest.
